correctness.rationale: TARGET route: the submitted headline is a disproof of the target's definite description, not the originally hoped-for Z* table. Verified independently by direct fetch on 2026-09-11: (1) HAP official Bogomolov page states Moravec theorem 'If G is isoclinic to H then B0(G) is isomorphic to B0(H)' and publishes exhaustive loop 'for n in [2,4,8,16,32,64,128] do for G in AllSmallGroups(n)' with NonTrivial output whose order-64 entries are exactly [64,149],[64,150],[64,151],[64,170],[64,171],[64,172],[64,177],[64,178],[64,182]; [64,199] absent, hence B0(64,199)=0 vs B0!=0 on the nine. (2) Jena catalogue page 64gp199 directly re-fetched: Hall-Senior 106, 4 minimal generators, exponent 4, centre rank 2; spot re-fetch of 64gp149 (HS229) and 64gp182 (HS227) confirms the fingerprint mapping method; full nine-to-HS225-233 block attested by committed harvest log. (3) Logic is valid modus tollens: one isoclinism class has uniform B0 by (1), so no single class contains both a B0-trivial and a B0-nontrivial group. Target text 'Let F be the full Hall isoclinism stem family ... containing SmallGroup(64,199) (the Bogomolov-positive family)' asserts such an F; therefore F as described does not exist. Version-drift escape correctly closed: B0 attaches to isomorphism type, relabelling cannot move a trivial class into a nontrivial family. No Z* value, capability status, or class mapping is claimed; scope limitation stated honestly. This is deductive proof from published premises, not experimental computation; no GAP run is required and none is pretended.

Title/embedding similarity alone was not used; theorem hypotheses and table contents were compared literally.

value.rationale: TARGET audit: the headline is a complete TARGET resolution by impossibility (subject does not exist), which is independently worth retrieving. Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the admitted topic (anchor SmallGroup(64,199), nine Bogomolov-positive stems, capability/B0/isoclinism boundary in Ellis-Moravec-Jezernik line); the B0-disjointness/non-isoclinism fact is not textbook, not a parameter substitution, and not a mechanical lookup — it diagnoses a material misidentification in the target that would otherwise waste exterior-square effort. It is a rigorously established exact invariant fact (B0 trivial vs nontrivial with isoclinism consequence) that a future researcher needs to avoid conflating the anchor family with the B0-positive family and to redirect any Z*/capability work to correctly scoped families. Narrowness does not defeat value under the exact-invariant standard; certification via replayable harvest does not rescue an arbitrary number but this object is non-arbitrary (admitted anchor + census block).
